prompt:
Photograph of a sleek Dutch light frigate of about 1665, a low-slung,
fine-lined hull with one continuous row of gun ports and a short raised
bow deck, a modest raised quarterdeck ending in a flat carved transom
with light gilding: square courses, topsails and topgallants, a lateen
mizzen under a small square topsail, a spritsail and spritsail topsail,
a black hull with yellow-ochre bands and red gun-port lids, under sail
at sea, seen from low over the water, her bow to the left and a little
towards us, a blue sea with white crests and the open sea running to the
horizon all round her and a sky of soft even blue with a few white
clouds, a natural photograph with no frame, no border and no circle.
Historical reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic. The whole
ship is built of planked wood: no tower, nothing of stone.
